scientific.integrity: The all-order conclusion follows from an explicit simplex comparison and a circular-arc nerve argument. Literature searches are evidence for originality but do not constitute a proof of novelty.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is for a single adjacent edge reversal in the cyclic tournament; no claim is made for arbitrary edge reversals or multiple reversals. The bundled computation checks odd orders through 17 and is supplemental to the all-order proof.

title: A single adjacent reversal contracts the cyclic tournament flag complex
